rows.name: Mental Health Legislative Advisory Council
rows.mandate: Advises the Minnesota legislature on mental health policy, program funding, and data-informed behavioral health system improvements. Reports directly to legislative committees.

rows.name: Council on Disability
rows.mandate: Advises the state on policies, programs, and services for Minnesotans with disabilities. Advocates for rights, accessibility, and inclusion across all state programs.

rows.name: Criminal & Juvenile Justice Information Policy Group
rows.mandate: Governs Minnesota's criminal and juvenile justice data infrastructure, interoperability standards, and privacy policy for statewide information sharing systems.

rows.name: Water Council
rows.mandate: Coordinates Minnesota's water policy, resource management strategy, and interagency water governance. Advises on statewide water planning and federal Clean Water Act compliance.

rows.name: Human Rights Advisory Council
rows.mandate: Advises the Minnesota Department of Human Rights on discrimination case policy, equity initiatives, and civil rights programs for all Minnesotans.

rows.name: Housing Finance Agency Advisory Council
rows.mandate: Advises on affordable housing finance programs, federal HOME and CDBG funding allocation, and data systems for housing program management.

rows.name: Child Protection Training & Certification Board
rows.mandate: Oversees training and certification standards for child protection workers across Minnesota. Sets professional competencies and reviews program quality for the child welfare workforce.

rows.name: Board of Medical Practice
rows.mandate: Regulates the licensure and discipline of physicians in Minnesota. Protects patient safety through license review, investigation of complaints, and medical practice standards.

rows.name: Board of Teaching
rows.mandate: Oversees the licensure and professional development standards for Minnesota's K-12 teachers. Sets educator competencies and reviews teacher preparation program quality.

rows.name: Governor's Workforce Development Board
rows.mandate: Oversees Minnesota's federal Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA) implementation. Manages statewide workforce data systems, employer engagement strategy, and federally-required program accountability.

rows.name: Pollution Control Citizens Advisory Committee
rows.mandate: Advises Minnesota's Pollution Control Agency on permit policy, environmental justice, and regulatory standards. Provides community perspective on environmental compliance decisions.

rows.name: Indian Affairs Council
rows.mandate: Serves as the primary liaison between the 11 Tribal Nations of Minnesota and state government. Addresses sovereignty, treaty rights, and tribal-state consultation on policy decisions.

rows.name: Rehabilitation Council for the Blind
rows.constituent: Minnesotans who are blind or low vision
rows.mandate: Advises Minnesota State Services for the Blind on vocational rehabilitation programs, independent living policy, and technology access for Minnesotans who are blind or have low vision.

rows.name: State Demographic Center Advisory Committee
rows.mandate: Guides Minnesota's official population data collection, equity data strategy, and data product development for state planning and policy decisions.
